summary_en: The diocese of Cremona (Italy) may inscribe either the Blessed Virgin Mary 'de Caravagio' or Saint Homobonus in its proper calendar with the title of principal patron, notwithstanding n. 31 of the Instruction on particular calendars and n. 5 of 'De Patronis constituendis'; two celebrations named, so none singled out.
excerpt: Cremonensis, 11 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1584/85): conceditur ut sive beata Maria Virgo « de Caravagio » sive Sanctus Homobonus in Calendario proprio dioecesis titulo « Patroni principalis » inscribi possint, normis n. 31 Instructionis « De Calendariis particularibus atque Officiorum et Missarum Propriis recognoscendis » et n. 5 « De Patronis constituendis » haud obstantibus.

target.institute: Congregatio Passionis

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Pius a S. Aloisio Campidelli

summary_en: The Congregation of the Passion may insert the celebration of Blessed Pius of St Aloysius Campidelli into its proper calendar, on 3 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Congregatio Passionis, 12 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1205/85): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Pii a S. Aloisio Campidelli in Calendarium proprium Congregationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Sorores Missionariae Regalitatis D.N.I.C.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Missionary Sisters of the Kingship of Our Lord Jesus Christ (D.N.I.C.) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol and the page ends there, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Sorores Missionariae Regalitatis D.N.I.C., 12 decembris 1985 (Prot. 483/85).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Perpetuo Succursu

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Virgen del perpetuo Socorro' as patroness before God of the diocese of Arecibo (Puerto Rico) is confirmed.
excerpt: Arecibensis, 10 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1516/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Virgen del perpetuo Socorro » Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Arecibensis.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Maximilianus Maria Kolbe

summary_en: The election of Saint Maximilian Mary Kolbe as patron before God of the radio amateurs of Argentina is confirmed (patron of a category of persons).
excerpt: Argentina, 4 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1725/83): confirmatur electio Sancti Maximiliani Mariae Kolbe Patroni apud Deum Radioamatorum Nationis Argentinae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'de Monte Carmelo' as patroness before God of the Venezuelan Army is confirmed (patron of the armed forces).
excerpt: Venetiola, 10 decembris 1985 (Prot. 1574/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « de Monte Carmelo » Patronae apud Deum Exercitus Venetiolani.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Lauretana

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Lauretana' as patroness before God of the Venezuelan Air Force is confirmed (patron of the armed forces).
excerpt: Eodem die (Prot. 1575/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Lauretanae » Patronae apud Deum militum Aëriae Classis Venetiolanae.

target.institute: Congregatio Cooperatorum Paroecialium Christi Regis

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Congregation of Parish Cooperators of Christ the King recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Congregatio Cooperatorum Paroecialium Christi Regis, 29 novembris 1985 (Prot. 1422/85).

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum b. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel (Carmelites) may insert three celebrations into its proper calendar, each as an optional memorial: Blessed Mary of Jesus Crucified (Bouardy), virgin, 25 August; Blessed Raphael of St Joseph (Kalinowski), priest, 19 November; Blessed Elizabeth of the Trinity (Catez), virgin, 8 November.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum b. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, Provinciae in Gallia

celebration.name_latin: Beata Francisca Amboise

summary_en: The two Provinces in France of the Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Frances d'Amboise, religious, into their proper calendar, on 5 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum b. Mariae V. de Monte Carmelo, Provinciae in Gallia, 28 ianuarii 1986 (Prot. 221/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Franciscae Amboise, religiosae, in Calendarium proprium duarum Provinciarum eiusdem Ordinis in Gallia inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Societas Iesu

summary_en: The Society of Jesus may insert three celebrations into its proper calendar, each as an optional memorial: Blessed Diego de San Vitores, priest and martyr, 6 October; Blessed José María Rubio, priest, 4 May; Blessed Francisco Gárate, religious, 10 September.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Succursu (Nuestra Señora del Socorro)

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora del Socorro' as patroness before God of the city and archdiocese of Valencia (Venezuela) is confirmed; the same protocol is listed again in Notitiae 238 p. 321 with the date 13 February 1986 and the wording 'dioecesis Valentinae', so the date of the act is uncertain.
excerpt: Valentina in Venetiola, 7 ianuarii 1986 (Prot. 1525/85): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora del Socorro » civitatis et archidioecesis apud Deum Patronae.

celebration.name_latin: Missa pro « Anzac day »

summary_en: The dioceses of Australia may celebrate the Mass called 'Anzac day' every year on 25 April; a fixed-date Mass rather than a graded celebration, so the grade is left null.
excerpt: Australiae dioeceses, 12 martii 1986 (Prot. 1191/86): conceditur ut Missa pro « Anzac day » nuncupata quotannis die 25 aprilis celebrari valeat.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Cremona (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Cremonensis, 26 martii 1986 (Prot. 1583/85).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Ioannes a Sancta Martha

summary_en: The liturgical celebration of Blessed John of St Martha, priest and martyr, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Church of Tarragona (Spain), on 16 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Tarraconensis, 15 martii 1986 (Prot. 374/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Ioannis a Sancta Martha, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium Ecclesiae Tarraconensis inseri valeat, quotannis die 16 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio Sororum a Sancto Felice

excerpt: Congregatio Sororum a Sancto Felice, 18 martii 1986 (Prot. 367/86).

target.institute: Familiae Franciscales (OFM, OFM Conv., OFM Cap.), Provinciae Flandriae

summary_en: The Franciscan families (OFM, OFM Conv., OFM Cap.) of the Province of Flanders may insert some changes (not specified on the page) into their proper Franciscan calendar.
excerpt: Familiae Franciscales (OFM, OFM Conv., OFM Cap.), Provinciae Flandriae, 14 februarii 1986 (Prot. 195/86): conceditur ut aliquae immutationes in Calendarium Franciscanum Proprium inseri valeant.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Angelus, presbyter

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel may insert the celebration of Saint Angelus, priest, into its proper calendar, on 5 May each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 12 februarii 1986 (Prot. 167/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Angeli, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 maii gradu memoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Titus Brandsma, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel may insert the celebration of Blessed Titus Brandsma, priest and martyr, into its proper calendar on 27 July each year: as an optional memorial in the churches of the Order, and as an obligatory memorial in the churches of the Order's Dutch Province.

target.institute: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio S. Crucis de Cono Sur

celebration.name_latin: In Exaltatione Sanctae Crucis

summary_en: In the monasteries of the Benedictine Congregation of the Holy Cross of the Southern Cone, and in the monasteries of the nuns associated with it, the titular celebration of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross may be kept on 14 September each year as a solemnity.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Congregatio S. Crucis de Cono Sur, 7 februarii 1986 (Prot. 259/86): conceditur ut in monasteriis Congregationis necnon in monasteriis Sororum quae ipsi Congregationi sociantur, celebratio titularis « In exaltatione Sanctae Crucis » quotannis die 14 septembris gradu sollemnitatis peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Monasteria Sublacensia

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Benedictine Subiaco monasteries recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol; the same protocol appears on p. 318 as the confirmation of the Latin and Italian text of their Proper of the Liturgy of the Hours, so the calendar act may be part of that decree.
excerpt: Ordo Sancti Benedicti, Monasteria Sublacensia, 21 martii 1986 (Prot. 978/85).

target.institute: Sorores Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Provinciae Quebecensis, Abbatia « Sainte-Marie-des-deux-montagnes »

excerpt: Sorores Ordinis Sancti Benedicti Provinciae Quebecensis, Abbatia « Sainte-Marie-des-deux-montagnes », 14 februarii 1986 (Prot. 216/86).

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Maria Magdalena

summary_en: The election of Saint Mary Magdalene as patroness before God of the village called Walleshausen, in the diocese of Augsburg (Germany), is confirmed (a single locality).
excerpt: Augustana Vindelicorum, 21 martii 1986 (Prot. 673/86): confirmatur electio Sanctae Mariae Magdalenae pagi « Walleshausen » nuncupati apud Deum Patronae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo (Nossa Senhora do Carmo)

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nossa Senhora do Carmo' as patroness before God of the soldiers of the public security force called 'Guarda Nacional Republicana' in the dioceses of Portugal is confirmed (patron of an armed force).
excerpt: Lusitaniae dioeceses, 26 februarii 1986 (Prot. 321/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nossa Senhora do Carmo » in Patronam apud Deum militum a publica tutela qui « Guarda Nacional Republicana » nuncupantur.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Ioseph, Sponsus beatae Mariae Virginis

summary_en: The election of Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, as patron before God of the diocese of Rivera (Uruguay) is confirmed.
excerpt: Rivoriensis, 17 februarii 1986 (Prot. 246/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Iosephi, Sponsi beatae Mariae Virginis, in Patronum apud Deum dioecesis Rivoriensis.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Antonius Maria Gianelli, episcopus

summary_en: The election of Saint Anthony Mary Gianelli, bishop, as patron before God of the parish community of Carro, in the diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy), is confirmed (a single parish).
excerpt: Spediensis - Sarzanensis - Brugnatensis, 4 martii 1986 (Prot. 316/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Antonii Mariae Gianelli, episcopi, communitatis paroecialis Carrensis Patroni apud Deum.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Nola (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol; a text confirmation for Nola of the same date is listed on p. 386 under Prot. 1355/85, so the calendar act may belong to that decree and one of the two protocol numbers may be a misprint.
excerpt: Nolana, 2 maii 1986 (Prot. 1335/86).

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Trieste (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Tergestina, 29 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 480/85).

target.institute: Congregatio « Opera Matris Orphanorum »

summary_en: The Congregation 'Opera Matris Orphanorum' may insert into its proper calendar the celebrations of Saint Jerome Emiliani on 8 February and of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Orphans, on 27 September, each as a solemnity (one line covers this institute and the Missionary Daughters of St Jerome Emiliani, Prot. 499/86).
excerpt: Congregatio « Opera Matris Orphanorum », 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 498/86) - Missionariae Filiae S. Hieronymi Emiliani, 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 499/86): conceditur ut celebrationes Sancti Hieronymi Emiliani, die 8 februarii, necnon beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Orphanorum, die 27 septembris, in Calendaria propria inseri valeant, quotannis gradu sollemnitatis peragendae.

target.institute: Missionariae Filiae S. Hieronymi Emiliani

summary_en: The Missionary Daughters of St Jerome Emiliani may insert into their proper calendar the celebrations of Saint Jerome Emiliani on 8 February and of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Orphans, on 27 September, each as a solemnity (one line covers this institute and the Congregation 'Opera Matris Orphanorum', Prot. 498/86).
excerpt: Congregatio « Opera Matris Orphanorum », 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 498/86) - Missionariae Filiae S. Hieronymi Emiliani, 21 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 499/86): conceditur ut celebrationes Sancti Hieronymi Emiliani, die 8 februarii, necnon beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Orphanorum, die 27 septembris, in Calendaria propria inseri valeant, quotannis gradu sollemnitatis peragendae.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Cyriacus Elias Chavara, presbyter

summary_en: The Order of Brothers of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel may insert the celebration of Blessed Cyriac Elias Chavara, priest, into its proper calendar, on 3 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 25 aprilis 1986 Prot. 492/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Cyriaci Eliae Chavara, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Auxilium Christianorum

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Help of Christians' as patroness before God of the public security officers of the Principality of Andorra is confirmed (patron of a category of persons).
excerpt: Andurensis Principatus, 14 maii 1986 (Prot. 559/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum » in Patronam apud Deum ministrorum publicae securitatis Andurensis Principatus.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, sub titulo Visitationis

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Visitation as patroness before God of the members of the Pontifical Institute of Sacred Music (Rome) is confirmed (patron of an institution's members, not of a territory).
excerpt: Pontificium Institutum Musicae Sacrae, 6 maii 1986 (Prot. 1540/85): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo Visitationis, sodalium eiusdem Pontificii Instituti apud Deum Patronae.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of the Immaculate Conception as patroness before God of the diocese of Tampico (Mexico) is confirmed.
excerpt: Tampicensis, 3 aprilis 1986 (Prot. 243/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis Patronae apud Deum eiusdem dioecesis.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Gumbertus, episcopus et abbas

summary_en: The celebration of Saint Gumbert, bishop and abbot, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Würzburg (Germany), on 15 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Herbipolensis, 25 iulii 1986 (Prot. 776/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Gumberti, episcopi et abbatis, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 15 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

summary_en: Two variations are introduced into the proper calendar of the diocese of Luçon (France): the celebration of the Blessed Martyrs of the diocese of Angers is inserted on 1 February as an optional memorial, and the celebration of Saint Henri Dorie, priest and martyr, is transferred from 8 March to 20 September as an obligatory memorial together with the other Korean martyr companions.

In the diocese of Eisenstadt (Austria) the memorials of Saint Leopold, Margrave of Austria, and of Saint Stephen, King of Hungary, may henceforth be celebrated as obligatory memorials on the days assigned to them in the calendar, because of the special devotion paid to these two saints there since ancient times.
excerpt: Sideropolitana, 24 iunii 1986 (Prot. 738/86): conceditur ut memoria Sancti Leopoldi Marchionis Austriae necnon memoria Sancti Stephani Hungariae Regis, ob peculiarem cultum his duobus Sanctis ab antiquis iam temporibus a fidelibus tributum, diebus in Calendario illis assignatis, in posterum gradu memoriae obligatoriae in dioecesi celebrari possint.

celebration.name_latin: Sancti Octavianus, Avventor ac Solutor, martyres

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Turin (Italy) the liturgical celebration of Saints Octavius, Adventor and Solutor may be transferred from 20 November to 20 January.
excerpt: Taurinensis, 5 augusti 1986 (Prot. 841/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Sanctorum Octaviani, Avventoris ac Solutoris a die 20 novembris ad diem 20 ianuarii transferri possit.

target.institute: Familiae Franciscales Poloniae

summary_en: Variations are granted for the proper calendar of the Franciscan families of Poland: 7 May Bl. Jeremiah of Wallachia, religious, optional memorial; 15 May St Margaret of Cortona, memorial; 23 May Dedication of the Basilica of St Francis in Assisi, feast; 14 July Sts John Jones and John Wall, martyrs (First Order), optional memorial; 14 July Bl. Angelina of Marsciano (Third Order), memorial; 2 September Bl. Beatrice da Silva, optional memorial; 15 November St Didacus of Alcalá, optional memorial.

target.institute: Moniales Benedictinae ab adoratione perpetua SS. Sacramenti, Foederatio gallica

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Maximilianus Maria Kolbe, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: The Benedictine Nuns of Perpetual Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament, French Federation, may insert the celebration of Saint Maximilian Mary Kolbe, priest and martyr, into their proper calendar, on 14 August each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Moniales Benedictinae ab adoratione perpetua SS. Sacramenti, Foederatio gallica, 2 iulii 1986 (Prot. 757/86): conceditur ut celebratio Sancti Maximiliani Mariae Kolbe, presbyteri et martyris, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Foederationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 14 augusti gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Moniales Clarissae, Foederatio Magnae Britanniae et Hiberniae

celebration.name_latin: S. Franciscus in Impressione Stigmatum

summary_en: The Poor Clare Nuns of the Federation of Great Britain and Ireland may insert the celebration of St Francis receiving the Stigmata into the Federation's proper calendar, on 17 September each year as a feast; the Federation spans two nations (GB and IE), so nation is left null.
excerpt: Moniales Clarissae, Foederatio Magnae Britanniae et Hiberniae, 8 iulii 1986 (Prot. 777/86): conceditur ut celebratio S. Francisci in Impressione Stigmatum in Calendarium proprium Foederationis inseri valeat, quotannis die 17 septembris gradu festi peragenda.

target.institute: Moniales Passionis Iesu Christi in Archidioecesi Ianuensi

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « della Guardia »

summary_en: The Passionist Nuns in the archdiocese of Genoa (Italy) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'della Guardia' into the proper calendar of their monastery, on 29 August each year as a feast, the memorial of the Passion of St John the Baptist being transferred to the following day, 30 August.
excerpt: Moniales Passionis Iesu Christi in Archidioecesi Ianuensi, 31 maii 1986 (Prot. 665/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « della Guardia » in Calendarium proprium eiusdem monasterii inseri valeat, quotannis die 29 augusti gradu festi peragenda, memoria autem « in Passione S. Ioannis Baptistae » ad sequentem diem 30 augusti translata.

target.institute: Ordo Clericorum Regularium Pauperum Matris Dei Scholarum Piarum

celebration.name_latin: Sanctissimum Nomen beatae Mariae Virginis

summary_en: The Order of Clerics Regular of the Poor of the Mother of God of the Pious Schools (Piarists) may transfer the celebration of the feast of the Most Holy Name of the Blessed Virgin Mary in its proper calendar from 8 May to 12 September; the printed protocol 673/86 is also carried by the Augsburg patron confirmation of 21 March 1986 (Notitiae 238 p. 320), so one of the two numbers is probably a misprint.
excerpt: Ordo Clericorum Regularium Pauperum Matris De Scholarum Piarum, 31 maii 1986 (Prot. 673/86): conceditur ut celebratio festi Sanctissimi Nominis beatae Mariae Virginis in Calendario proprio eiusdem Ordinis a die 8 maii ad diem 12 septembris transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo Clericorum Regularium Pauperum Matris Dei Scholarum Piarum

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Mater Dei Scholarum Piarum, Patrona Ordinis

summary_en: The Piarists may celebrate the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God of the Pious Schools, Patroness of the Order, on 8 May each year as a feast.
excerpt: Die 5 iunii 1986 (Prot. 672/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Die Scholarum Piarum, Patronae Ordinis, quotannis die 8 maii gradu festi peragi valeat.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Titus Brandsma

summary_en: The Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the liturgical celebration of Blessed Titus Brandsma into its proper calendar, on 27 July each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 16 iunii 1986 (Prot. 714/86): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beati Titi Brandsma in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 27 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia S. Petri martyris

celebration.name_latin: Beata Ioanna de Aza

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the Dominican Province of St Peter Martyr the celebration of Blessed Joan of Aza, mother of St Dominic, kept as an optional memorial, may be transferred from 2 to 3 August.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum, Provincia S. Petri martyris, 22 iulii 1986 (Prot. 769/86): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio eiusdem Provinciae celebratio Beatae Ioannae de Aza, sancti Dominici matris, quae gradu memoriae ad libitum peragitur, a die 2 ad diem 3 mensis augusti transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo SS. Salvatoris v. S. Birgittae

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the Order of the Most Holy Saviour of St Bridget recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the institute, date and protocol, with no text of the act.
excerpt: Ordo SS. Salvatoris v. S. Birgittae, 4 iulii 1986 (Prot. 607/86).

target.institute: Societas Iesu

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Iosephus M. Rubio

summary_en: The optional memorial of Blessed José María Rubio, inscribed on 4 May in the proper calendar of the Society of Jesus, may be transferred to 5 May.
excerpt: Societas Iesu, 16 iunii 1986 (Prot. 713/86): conceditur ut memoria ad libitum Beati Iosephi M. Rubio, in Calendario proprio die 4 maii inscripta, ad diem 5 maii transferri possit.

target.institute: Societas Presbyterorum SS.mi Cordis Iesu de Betharram

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria a Iesu Crucifixo, virgo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis

excerpt: Guinea Aequatorialis, 26 maii 1986 (Prot. 1596/83): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Immaculatae Conceptionis in Patronam apud Deum Nationis Guineae Aequatorialis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Virgen Bisila »

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Virgen Bisila' as patroness before God of the archdiocese of Malabo (Equatorial Guinea) is confirmed.
excerpt: Malaboënsis, 26 maii 1986 (Prot. 603/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo v. g. « Virgen Bisila » in Patronam apud Deum Archidioecesis Malaboënsis.

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Nuestra Señora de los dolores gloriosos' and of Saint Francis Borgia as patrons before God of the parish community of Our Lady's Nativity in Turís, archdiocese of Valencia (Spain), is confirmed (a single parish; two patrons named).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum »

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Help of Christians' may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Asidonia-Jerez (Spain), on 24 May each year as an obligatory memorial.
excerpt: Assidonensis-Ierezensis, 11 septembris 1986 (Prot. 911/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum » in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 maii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Ioannes de Faesulis seu Beatus Angelicus, presbyter

summary_en: The celebration of Blessed John of Fiesole (Fra Angelico), priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Fiesole (Italy), on 18 February each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Fesulana, 3 septembris 1986 (Prot. 889/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ioannis de Faesulis seu Beati Angelici, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 18 februarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Societas Divini Salvatoris – Congregatio sororum Divini Salvatoris

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Regina Apostolorum

summary_en: The Society of the Divine Saviour and the Congregation of the Sisters of the Divine Saviour may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen of Apostles, into their proper calendar, to be kept each year on the first Saturday after the Ascension of the Lord as a feast (movable date, so month/day are null).
excerpt: Societas Divini Salvatoris – Congregatio sororum Divini Salvatoris, 15 septembris 1986 (Prot. 355/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis Reginae Apostolorum in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis primo sabbato post Ascensionem Domini gradu festi peragenda.

summary_en: Norms of the Congregation for Divine Worship (dated 25 October 1986, no protocol printed) on the proper liturgical celebrations of the Italian dioceses united by decree n. 971/85 of the Congregation for Bishops of 30 September 1986: the anniversary of the dedication of the cathedral is a solemnity in the cathedral and a feast in the whole diocese, that of the concathedral a solemnity only in the concathedral; the principal patrons of the former dioceses become patrons of the new diocese and are celebrated with the same grade; other proper celebrations continue in the former territories with the same grade; the bishop is to draw up a new proper calendar per the Instruction Calendaria particularia n. 20.
excerpt: Secondo quanto stabilito nel Decreto della Congregazione per i Vescovi, i Patroni delle diocesi precedenti diventano Patroni della nuova diocesi. [...] Le altre celebrazioni proprie continueranno ad aver luogo nei territori delle precedenti diocesi, con lo stesso grado che avevano nel rispettivo calendario particolare.

summary_en: A Calendaria particularia entry for the diocese of Fidenza (Italy) recorded as a bare approval line: the Summarium prints only the diocese, date and protocol; the same protocol and date appear on p. 957 as the confirmation of the Italian text of the diocese's Proper of Masses and of the Liturgy of the Hours, so the calendar act may be part of that decree.
excerpt: Fidentina, 18 novembris 1986 (Prot. 985/86).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum »

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Help of Christians' may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Huelva (Spain), on 24 May each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Onubensis, 23 octobris 1986 (Prot. 1033/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Auxilium Christianorum », in Calendarium proprium dioecesis Onubensis inseri valeat, quotannis die 24 maii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, Regina Pacis

summary_en: The celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary, Queen of Peace, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Warmia (Poland), on 1 September each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Varmiensis, 15 novembris 1986 (Prot. 613/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis, Reginae Pacis, in Calendarium proprium dioecesis inseri valeat, quotannis die 1 septembris gradu memoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beata Teresia Maria a Cruce Manetti, virgo

summary_en: The Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Teresa Maria of the Cross Manetti, virgin, into its proper calendar, on 23 April each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo, 21 octobris 1986 (Prot. 992/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Teresiae Mariae a Cruce Manetti, virginis, in Calendarium proprium eiusdem Ordinis inseri valeat, quotannis die 23 aprilis gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum Beatae Mariae Virginis de Monte Carmelo

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Cyriacus Elias Chavara, presbyter

summary_en: The Order of Discalced Carmelites may insert the celebration of Blessed Cyriac Elias Chavara, priest, into its proper calendar, on 3 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Die 28 novembris 1986 (Prot. 1134/86): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Cyriaci Eliae Chavara, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 3 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Oblatae Benedictinae Monasterii « La paix Notre-Dame à Flée »

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo a Quercu (« Notre-Dame du chêne »)

summary_en: The Benedictine Oblates of the monastery 'La paix Notre-Dame' at Flée (France) may insert the celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary of the Oak ('Notre-Dame du chêne') into the monastery's proper calendar, on 1 September each year as a memorial.
excerpt: Oblatae Benedictinae Monasterii « La paix Notre-Dame à Flée », 14 novembris 1986 (Prot. 1086/86): conceditur ut celebratio beatae Mariae Virginis a Quercu v.d. « Notre-Dame du chêne » in Calendarium proprium monasterii inseri valeat, quotannis die 1 septembris gradu memoriae peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Auxilium Christianorum (« Auxiliadora de los cristianos »)

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title 'Auxiliadora de los cristianos' as patroness before God of the diocese of Punta Arenas (Chile) is confirmed.
excerpt: Punta Arenas, 15 novembris 1986 (Prot. 865/86): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Auxiliadora de los cristianos » dioecesis apud Deum Patronae.

summary_en: The election of Saint Joseph, spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, as principal patron before God of the diocese of San Jose in California (USA), and of Saint Clare of Assisi as secondary patroness, is confirmed (two patrons named).
excerpt: Sanctus Ioseph in California, 15 novembris 1986 (Prot. 736/86): confirmatur electio Sancti Ioseph, beatae Mariae Virginis sponsi, dioecesis apud Deum Patroni principalis, atque Sanctae Clarae Assisiensis Patronae secundariae.
